segments.text: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David,

segments.speaker: Achish
segments.text: Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.
And David said to Achish,

segments.speaker: Achish
segments.text: Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do.

segments.speaker: Achish
segments.text: And Achish said to David,
Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head

segments.speaker: Achish
segments.text: for ever.
¶ Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.
And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.
And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.
And when Saul enquired of the LORD, the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
¶ Then said Saul unto his servants,

segments.speaker: Saul's servants
segments.text: Seek me a woman

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold,
there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.
And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said,

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.
And the woman said unto him,

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?
And Saul sware to her by the LORD, saying,

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: As the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.

segments.speaker: The Woman
segments.text: Then said the woman,
Whom shall I bring up unto thee?

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: And he said,
Bring me up Samuel.
And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying,

segments.speaker: The Woman
segments.text: Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: And the king said unto her,
Be not afraid:

segments.speaker: The king
segments.text: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul,

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: I saw gods
ascending out of the earth.

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: And he said unto her, What form is he of?
And she said,

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: An old man cometh up;
and he is covered with a mantle.

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: And Saul perceived that it was Samuel,
and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.
¶ And Samuel said to Saul,

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered,

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: I am sore distressed;
for the Philistines make war against me,

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.

footnotes: by prophets: Heb. by the hand of prophets
heading: Samuel's Prophecy

segments.speaker: Samuel
segments.text: Then said Samuel,
Wherefore then dost thou ask of me,

segments.speaker: Samuel
segments.text: seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?

segments.speaker: Samuel
segments.text: And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:

segments.speaker: Samuel
segments.text: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.

segments.speaker: Samuel
segments.text: Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.
Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

footnotes: fell: Heb. made haste, and fell with the fulness of his stature

segments.text: ¶ And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: The woman
segments.text: Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.

segments.speaker: The Woman
segments.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.
But he refused, and said, I will not eat.

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice.
So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.
And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:
And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
